QuestInfo.name: Traveling Around Maple 2
QuestInfo.0: After soaking up the sun at Florina Beach, I should start up a conversation with Riel.
QuestInfo.1: Riel offered to take me to Showa Town. Once I get there, she advised me to look for Skye...
QuestInfo.2: I was able to meet up with Skye. Where will I go next?

0.0: Alright, how was Florina Beach? Did you like it? Ready to go to the next spot?

yes.0: Alright, I'll send you to Showa Town. It's a very interesting place with a nice view to boot.
yes.1: Once you arrive there, talk to #eSkye#n, and she'll take you to another spot.
yes.2: Oh yeah, if you step outside, you'll encounter very scary individuals, so if you aren't ready for them, I suggest you to stay inside.

no.0: Hey, you like it here, huh? Make yourself comfortable here.

1.0: Oh, you're here through Riel? Go have yourself a bath at the bathhouse, and you'll find yourself relieving stress.
1.1: In any case, have yourself a skewer and check out the area!
